description: An on/off setting that applies the moment it is flipped (role="switch"). A checkbox is for something that applies when a form is submitted. Copy: the label names the state when ON, and never repeats the word "on": "Weekly digest", not "Weekly digest on/off".

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled: the switch draws what it is told and never its own state, so a flip that the save rejects must not stay flipped.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the NEXT value. It is where the save goes; the switch does not move until `checked` comes back changed.

props.name: invalid
props.description: The form rejected this setting. Red track and a red focus ring; the message belongs to the `<Field>` around it.

example: const [on, setOn] = useState(true)<Switch checked={on} onChange={setOn} label="Weekly digest" />
